messages.fillInstructions:
How to fill this form
  1. Page URL and page title are filled automatically and cannot be changed.
  2. Write a clear description: what you did, what you expected, what happened.
  3. Attach one or more screenshots (required when possible).
Only description and screenshots are editable after you save.
